infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Moja Driver requires background GPS telemetry to stream vehicle position, calculate accurate passenger ETAs, and power fleet dispatch.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Moja Driver requires your location to navigate routes and verify terminal check-ins.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Moja Driver uses the camera to scan and validate passenger QR ticket barcodes.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Moja Driver to stream live vehicle telemetry to passengers and dispatchers.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Moja Driver to access camera for scanning passenger boarding tickets.
